newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower on rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower on rate cut.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) fell across all maturities on Monday, mirroring the drop in the Central Bank's overnight rates, traders said.
Earlier in the day, the Central Bank lowered its overnight borrowing and lending rates by 1.50 percentage points each to 11.00 and 13.00 percent respectively.

Last week, the Central Bank had to sharply raise its overnight rates to curb speculation on the peso. The raise in overnight rates had dampened speculation and the foreign exchange market returned to its normal sedate trading last Friday.
